research.title: JCGM VIM3 §1.1 — quantity
research.adopted: Quantity is a property with magnitude, expressed using number/reference.
research.rejected: Not the instrument, bare numeral, object name or a universal visible-unit requirement.
research.usageRestrictions: Normative comparison; original paraphrase and illustrations, no protected tables copied.

research.title: JCGM VIM3 §1.19 — quantity value
research.read: Definition, examples and note1 including dimension-one values.
research.adopted: Separate property from its value and allow dimension-one values without an explicit printed unit.
research.limitations: Conceptual simplification; no calibration or uncertainty certification.

research.title: JCGM VIM3 §1.30 — nominal property
research.read: Definition, examples, notes and informative2013 colour annotation.
research.adopted: Distinguish a nominal description/code from a magnitude without blanket claims that colour/shape cannot be studied quantitatively.
research.rejected: Lite notQtyScene whole-category denial based on four unsuitable instruments.
research.usageRestrictions: Original paraphrase only; no source graphics copied.

research.title: BIPM — SI Brochure concise summary, updated2026
research.read: Official2026 landing page and linked concise summary Table1 quantity/unit relationships; full brochure not claimed read.
research.adopted: Use accurate property/unit examples, including length/metre, mass/kilogram, time/second.
research.limitations: No unit-definition memorization or conversion requirement.
research.usageRestrictions: Landing page CC BY4. No copied source figures; supplied PNG rights separate.
